title: Bounds after appending a memory tape
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $m+k_D$ work tapes, and append a memory tape with contents $M$ and head position $p$. If each of the first $m$ work-tape heads of $c$ lies in $[-1,W]$, each of its next $k_D$ work-tape heads has absolute position at most $B$, and $|p|\le P$, then the resulting configuration has those same respective bounds on its first $m$ heads and next $k_D$ heads, and its appended memory head has absolute position at most $P$.
hypotheses_covered: Each of the first $m$ head positions lies between $-1$ and $W$
Each of the next $k_D$ head positions has absolute value at most $B$
The appended memory-head position satisfies $|p|\le P$
